reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.19 (ASN.1 unaligned PER): lat 30.00900273: (x - 0) * 10000000 / 1 = 300090027.3 (in doubles), rounded to 300090027; every other key absent, written per ruling 1. 120 bits, padded to 15 octets. Derived without an engine by a standalone X.691 reference program (Python standard library) and checked against two independent ASN.1 UPER codecs on the ASN.1 module in the pack header: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper; asn1tools checks y (INTEGER (-5..MAX)) only as a length and octets, because it encodes a semi-constrained integer as an unconstrained one, which X.691 does not.
